top_signals.title: Treasuries Gain as Oil Prices Tumble After Democrats Elected
top_signals.summary: Treasuries rose as the outcome of the US midterm elections contributed to steep declines for oil prices based on the prospect of an end to the war in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The Army’s Command-and-Control Reboot
top_signals.summary:
How the Army makes decisions, communicates orders, coordinates forces, and keeps operations moving toward a common goal is undergoing a revolution. It’s called Next Generation Command and Control. Two of its architects — Lt. Gen. Matthew W. McFarlane, commanding general of I Corps, and Maj. Gen. Patrick J. Ellis, commanding general of the 4th Infantry Division — joined us to discuss this important set of organizational and technological innovations.Our thanks to AeroVironment for sponsoring the event at which this episode was recorded.Image: Kathryn Bailey via DVIDS

top_signals.title: Google responds to political backlash over removing search from schools that ban AI
top_signals.summary: After elected officials voiced outrage over Google turning off search at schools that ban AI, the company said search can be turned back on with AI Overviews.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Canton’s CC rises 4% as SEC staff view it as ‘digital commodity’
top_signals.summary: SEC staff’s no-action letter covers CC earned by running infrastructure and applications, but is not a binding ruling on its legal status.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
